# gyro_prepaid_estimate (Data Source)

Cost of prepaid (hourly, from the account balance) Gyro Cloud Istanbul servers, Gyro Containers plans and Gyro Containers Serverless containers, and how long the current balance would last. Amounts are in your account currency, VAT excluded. Nothing is ordered. Requires the billing_read scope.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# What would two 0.5 vCPU / 1 GB serverless containers and one Istanbul server cost?
data "gyro_prepaid_estimate" "stack" {
  items = [
    { cpu_m = 500, memory_mi = 1024, count = 2, hours = 730 },
    { plan = "standart-2-4" },
  ]
}

output "monthly" {
  value = "${data.gyro_prepaid_estimate.stack.monthly} ${data.gyro_prepaid_estimate.stack.currency}"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `items` (Attributes List) Up to 50 items. A plan item sets plan (or product_id); a serverless container item sets cpu_m + memory_mi (pairs: data.gyro_container_sizes). (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--items))

### Read-Only

- `balance` (Number)
- `can_order` (Boolean)
- `currency` (String)
- `daily` (Number)
- `hourly` (Number)
- `hours_covered` (Number) How many hours the balance would carry these items plus what is already running.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `monthly` (Number)
- `order_requires` (Number) Balance needed to order these items (first 24 hours).

<a id="nestedatt--items"></a>
### Nested Schema for `items`

Optional:

- `count` (Number) Copies / servers (default 1, max 100).
- `cpu_m` (Number) Serverless container: CPU per copy in millicores (250, 500, 1000, 2000, 4000).
- `hours` (Number) Serverless container: running hours for total (default 730 = a full month; no monthly cap).
- `memory_mi` (Number) Serverless container: memory per copy in MiB.
- `plan` (String) Prepaid plan name, e.g. standart-2-4 or ecs-baslangic.
- `product_id` (Number)

Read-Only:

- `capped` (Boolean) true: the item never costs more than its monthly price in a calendar month.
- `hourly_eur` (Number)
- `monthly` (Number) Monthly price (capped plans) or a full month (730 hours) of running time (serverless; no monthly cap).
- `monthly_eur` (Number)
- `total` (Number) Serverless: hours x hourly; plans: same as monthly.
- `type` (String) server, container or serverless.
